blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: reducir oraciones subordinadas con una forma en -ing o en -ed
reducir oraciones de relativo (the woman sitting next to me)

head: Frase completa
Reducida
rows: Because she felt tired, she went to bed.
Feeling tired, she went to bed.
After he had finished his work, he went home.
Having finished his work, he went home.
When it is seen from above, the city looks small.
Seen from above, the city looks small.
As I didn't know what to do, I called my mum.
Not knowing what to do, I called my mum.
While I was walking home, I met Tom.
Walking home, I met Tom.

blocks.title: ¿Qué forma?
bullets: -ing: lo hace el propio sujeto, a la vez o como causa (Feeling tired, ...), como el gerundio Sintiéndose cansada, ...
having + participio: pasó antes (Having eaten, we left.), como Habiendo comido, ... o Después de comer, ...
participio (-ed): sentido pasivo (Built in 1900, the house ...), como Construida en 1900, la casa ...
not va delante: Not having a car, I walk everywhere. (Como no tengo coche, ...)

blocks.text: La parte reducida se refiere al sujeto de la frase principal. Si no es así, la frase queda rara o graciosa.

head: Incorrecto
Correcto
rows: Walking down the street, a car hit me. (¿el coche iba andando?)
Walking down the street, I was hit by a car.
Having finished dinner, the dishes were washed.
Having finished dinner, we washed the dishes.

blocks.title: El español es más flexible
blocks.text: En español se dice sin problema Paseando por la calle, me atropelló un coche, aunque el que paseaba eras tú. En inglés eso es un error: el sujeto tiene que ser quien pasea: Walking down the street, I was hit by a car. Y al + infinitivo (Al llegar a casa, ...) se traduce con On arriving home, ... o When I got home, ...

head: Completa
Reducida
rows: The woman who is sitting next to me is a doctor.
The woman sitting next to me is a doctor.
The goods which were ordered last week have arrived.
The goods ordered last week have arrived.
Anyone who wants to join should register.
Anyone wanting to join should register.
He was the first person who arrived.
He was the first person to arrive.

blocks.title: Construcciones de participio fijas
items: dado que, teniendo en cuenta que
siempre que, con tal de que

rows: Walking down the street, a car hit me.
Walking down the street, I was hit by a car.
El participio se refiere al sujeto.
Having finish the work, I left.
Having finished the work, I left.
having + participio.
Knowing not the answer, she stayed silent.
Not knowing the answer, she stayed silent.
not delante.
The man sat next to me was rude.
The man sitting next to me was rude.
Activo y a la vez: -ing.
Building in 1900, the house is very old.
Built in 1900, the house is very old.
Pasivo: participio.
He was the first in arriving.
He was the first to arrive.
Después de the first: to + verbo.

blocks.text: Completa con la forma correcta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: ______ tired, I went to bed early.
items.full: Feeling tired, I went to bed early.

items.q: ______ finished the report, she sent it to her boss.
items.full: Having finished the report, she sent it to her boss.

items.q: ______ in 1890, the bridge is still in use.
items.full: Built in 1890, the bridge is still in use.

items.q: ______ knowing the way, we asked for directions.
items.full: Not knowing the way, we asked for directions.

items.q: The girl ______ by the window is my sister.
items.full: The girl standing by the window is my sister.

items.q: The books ______ last week have arrived.
items.full: The books ordered last week have arrived.

items.q: She was the first woman ______ the prize.
items.full: She was the first woman to win the prize.

items.q: ______ that it's raining, let's stay in.
items.full: Given that it's raining, let's stay in.

items.q: ______ by his accent, he's from Scotland.
items.full: Judging by his accent, he's from Scotland.

items.q: Generally ______, the weather here is mild.
items.full: Generally speaking, the weather here is mild.

items.q: Como estaba cansado, me fui a la cama temprano. (reducida)
items.a: Feeling tired, I went to bed early.

items.q: La mujer que está sentada a mi lado es médica. (reducida)
items.a: The woman sitting next to me is a doctor.
Generally speaking, it is quiet here.
